title: Duty Drawback 101: A Beginner's Guide to Tariff Refunds
summary: Learn how your business can reclaim up to 99% of duties, taxes, and fees paid on imported goods through the duty drawback program.
body_markdown:
## Ready to claim your refunds?


If you import and export (or destroy) goods, you're likely eligible for significant refunds through duty drawback. The question isn't whether you qualify — it's how much money you're leaving on the table.


**Start with Pax AI's free eligibility check** to see your potential refund amount. Our AI-powered platform makes duty drawback simple, automated, and accessible to businesses of all sizes. We only get paid when you get paid.
